svg.title: Preservation and revocation are separate operations
svg.desc: Keep sealed evidence storage and revoked credentials in different operational compartments. Preservation protects a record; revocation removes access. A wipe symbol over both would reverse the meaning. Visual distinction: An archival sleeve with folded corners and a continuous custody band. Its empty center holds preserved storage separately from live traffic; no records or checksums are invented.
